title: Findings and gaps
summary: Findings 2026-11-24 on ooRexx 5.3.0 trunk: dev37's native library fails to build under -Werror (unused parameter context from the RexxRoutine macros); with -Wno-unused-parameter the dev37 ooRexx session test passes; ooRexx charin on a pipe waits for end of file; mu_fence.nft drops unicast DHCP renewals to 168.63.129.16 UDP 67; nothing on an MU uses 169.254.169.254. Gaps to build: the daemon and /run/xtpd.sock protocol; native pump and fd passing (libxtp dev38); live operating-state change in the listener; emergency-file writer and parser; the xtp.provision actuator and identity resolver.
authority: design (architecture Tom Dyer; written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Fix the dev37 -Werror build before cats1 builds it
Accept unicast DHCP to 168.63.129.16 and drop IMDS in the skeleton fence
procedure: Treat each gap as its own package with its own tests

provenance.claim: XTP sessions: one context, both directions, per-direction close, one listener socket for all sessions
xtp.provision ingress gate only; no actuator or identity resolver

qualification_boundaries.status: dev1 built: packages/oorexx_xtpd_v0.1-dev1 (Claude (Opus 5.5), 24 Nov 2026) - registrations, peerages and keys from files, unix-socket OPEN with descriptor passing, exec hooks, the fence, receipts through oorexx_logging
qualification_boundaries.field: tested on loopback only (two daemons, real OpenSSH over UDP and raw IP 36); not field-tested; LDAP inputs, operating states, emergency files and the role bootstrap are not built
